category: hosted authentication and authorization (OIDC, OAuth 2.1, SAML, passwordless, RBAC)

free_tier.stated: Free plan at USD 0/month: up to 50,000 MAU, 50K access tokens, user authentication, one machine-to-machine app, Account APIs for account settings, audit logs and user management, 3 total applications, 3 social connectors and 1 custom domain; no credit card required
free_tier.notes: Only access tokens are counted for billing; ID tokens and refresh tokens are excluded. The Pro plan starts at USD 24/month with unlimited MAU, 50K tokens included and USD 0.08 per 100 extra, then paid add-ons. The pricing page does not state what happens when the Free MAU or token allowance is exceeded.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no per-object size cap is stated on the pages read; the Free plan is limited by count of applications and access tokens instead

retention.stated: Audit logs are retained 3 days on Free and 14 days on Pro; the Enterprise period is set by contract

egress.terms: not applicable: a hosted authentication API; no traffic allowance or per-GB egress price is published

interface_detail: A Logto Management API for programmatic control of tenants and resources, plus Experience API and Account API endpoints; a Management API is reachable at openapi.logto.io. The cloud service exposes a Cloud API used to create and subscribe tenants.
tooling: End-to-end tutorials and SDKs for web, mobile and native frameworks, the Logto Management API, the Account API, and the Logto Cloud API; the Logto Console configures sign-in.
chaining: An OIDC and OAuth 2.1 identity provider in front of apps on free compute, with password, passwordless, social and enterprise sign-in; user and tenant configuration is reachable through the Management API.

limits.value: up to 50,000 monthly active users on Free
50K access tokens per month, 3 total applications, 1 machine-to-machine app, 3 social connectors and 1 custom domain on Free
audit logs kept 3 days on Free
RBAC, Organizations, MFA, Enterprise SSO and SAML apps are add-ons and are not included on Free
1 tenant member included on Free, with further members charged on Pro

binding_note: The 50,000-MAU ceiling and the 50K-token allowance bind first; the 3-application cap binds sooner for a multi-app project, and RBAC and MFA need a paid add-on.

identity_cost.detail: The cloud sign-up page shows a Create your account form with an Email field and a Use Single Sign-On option. The pricing page states no credit card is required for Free. Whether a phone number or an identity document is asked for at a later step is unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: The first-party page does not describe enforcement when the Free MAU or token allowance is exceeded, so service behaviour past the quota is unverified. Audit logs are kept only 3 days on Free.
confidence_note: Quota, retention and add-on prices come from the first-party pricing page and the signup field from the first-party cloud sign-up page. No probe was run and no account was opened; a sign-up would confirm the post-quota behaviour and later identity fields.
